name: Heart Women & Girls
mission: We work to promote sexual health, uproot gendered violence, and advance reproductive justice—by establishing choice and access for the most impacted Muslims.
programs: RAHIM: Reproductive Agency Honoring Impacted Muslims
theoryOfChange: HEART builds the sexual health literacy of Muslim communities by offering sex education and anti-sexual assault advocacy. Our vision includes working toward a world where:• Individuals are valued for their character and personhood, rather than their body type, skin color, or what they choose to wear;• Individuals are free of guilt, shame, oppression, and violence, so that they are able to make informed and empowered decisions about their sexual health that aligns with their values; and• Gender equity is celebrated, consent and boundaries are honored, and space is made for those in need of support and resources.
